# Centralize

Centralize is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Centralize is a company that provides account mapping for enterprise sales. They offer a GPS for automatic mapping buying committees, finding missing stakeholders, and getting the next best move to close. Centralize employs 26 people, founded in 2023. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Canada.

## About

Centralize is the AI-powered relationship intelligence platform for enterprise sales teams. We've created automated stakeholder maps that help reps proactively multithread across departments, use conversation insights to say the right thing, and run pipeline reviews in minutes. We expedite the account planning process ahead of conversations to qualify deals in half the time and improve win rates by up to 56%.

# Centralize

Centralize is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Centralize employs 16 people (-11.1% YoY, -2 people), founded in 2023. Headquartered in Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States, with presence in South Africa.

## About

Centralizing the Workplace in a Decentralized World.

Your performance partner, where technology can make you faster, leaner, and more effective. Our mandate is to provide you with a toolset of technology-enhanced solutions that boost operational efficiency at the local level, all while aligning with our broader global objectives. 

Our mission is to create a unified platform that brings workplaces together, enabling organizations to excel in their operations and project execution amidst the ongoing decentralization movement across various interconnected domains, including energy generation, transportation, manufacturing, and agriculture.

We believe that the future belongs to those who can seamlessly integrate complex systems. We are committed to bridging the gap between decentralization and efficiency by harnessing the power of technology. Our focus is on integrating ERP systems, communication software, and CRM tools to foster collaboration, nurture effective teams, and drive productivity.

At the heart of our mission lies a vision of a workplace where boundaries vanish, and information flows effortlessly. We are dedicated to simplifying the complexities of the modern workplace, allowing organizations to adapt, innovate, and succeed in an ever-changing world.

Our commitment is to empower businesses with the tools they need to centralize their operations, streamline their processes, and achieve excellence. By uniting these diverse elements into a single, cohesive hub, we enable teams to work smarter, not harder.

In the face of decentralization, we are the beacon of centralization, guiding organizations toward a future where collaboration knows no boundaries.
